name: Plenty of fish in the sea! Can I find my true love after being teleported into an underwater world by a delivery truck?
source:
Our journey begins on Lake Well, where our protagonist, Shellby, decides to confess to the Girl in the Pink Dress. After being rejected by her, unfortunate Shellby is o̶b̶l̶i̶t̶e̶r̶a̶t̶e̶d̶ ̶b̶y̶ ̶a̶n̶ ̶o̶n̶c̶o̶m̶i̶n̶g̶ ̶t̶r̶u̶c̶k̶ ̶teleported magically into an underwater world by a majestic golden chariot to give him a second chance.

Now in a school for fish, utilizing your brand new fish body, you must find a date before prom comes around!

Will you find your true love?
Will you return to your former self?
Do you think free will actually exists?

[From [url=https://thestormwizard.itch.io/plenty-of-fish-in-the-sea]Itch.io[/url]]
